note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1925 original English description. The original is Nasutitermes (Convexitermes) kartaboensis, sp. nov., type locality Kartabo, British Guiana, described from numerous alates and several soldiers from 3 nests; later transferred to the genus Coatitermes by Fontes 1982. The worker is not described. In the original, the alate “length including wings” line is damaged in the OCR and is therefore not cited.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head oval in dorsal view, slightly narrowed behind the antennal bases; nasus dark brown, contrasting more strongly with the rest of the head than in N. mazaruniensis, its base rather thick, conical. Closely related to N. nigricornis but much smaller, and with the head slightly narrowed behind the antennal bases (N. nigricornis lacks this); almost impossible to distinguish from the soldier of N. mazaruniensis, differing only in the slightly darker nasus. Alate compared with N. mazaruniensis: pronotum slightly larger, wings distinctly longer (forewing 7.70—7.87 mm, versus 6.20—6.73 mm in the latter).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval; frontal gland pore (fontanelle) slit-like, forked at the end. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 and segment 3 equal in length, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Eyes rather large and prominent, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli medium-sized, usually separated from the eyes by slightly more than their width. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, median line faint or absent. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, sides slightly rounded, posterior margin nearly straight, anterior angles rather sharp. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Wings smoky, distinctly larger than in N. mazaruniensis. Abdominal tergites about the same colour as the pronotum. Measurements (mm): body length excluding wings 5.00—6.00, head length 0.93—0.97, head width 0.83—0.85, antennal length 1.43—1.47, eye diameter 0.27—0.29, pronotum length 0.46—0.47, pronotum width 0.70—0.73, hind tibia length 1.03—1.07, forewing length 7.70—7.87, forewing width 2.26—2.33.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval in dorsal view, with a very slight constriction behind the antennal bases; lateral profile nearly straight or slightly convex; head covered with fairly long hairs and a few longer setae. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 2 and segment 4 equal in length, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Nasus dark brown, contrasting more strongly with the rest of the head than in N. mazaruniensis; its base rather thick, conical, covered with short hairs. Pronotum pale. Abdomen coloured like the gut contents; tergites covered with fairly long hairs, with a row of setae on the posterior margin. Measurements (mm): total body length 3.30—3.50, head length 1.07, head width 0.55—0.57, antennal length 0.93, pronotum width 0.36, hind tibia length 0.53—0.57.
